headline: HMA is DE-RISKED BETA on every cell: up-market timing alpha is ~0 or massively NEGATIVE (-4918pp to -7307pp on coarse TFs), the engine NEVER beats HODL via up-market timing. The only value is bear-PRESERVATION (2022 dodge +18 to +69pp) + far lower maxDD (best cell 1d -28% vs HODL -82%). Best wealth cell = 1d (+4008%) but its vs_HODL is bear-preservation + rebalance premium, NOT timing alpha. Finer TFs DESTROY wealth (15m engine -96%) as cost+churn overwhelm the thinning capture edge. No genuinely positive up-market timing alpha worth flagging (the lone 15m +18pp upmkt is on a -96% wrecked near-zero-exposure book = degenerate artifact, not alpha).
limits: NO wealth holes -- all 12 cells have clean ma_wealth_driver wealth (fine-TF wealth is fast). WALL-CLOCK NOTE on capture: run_engine capture over u100 scales steeply with TF (1d ~20s, 4h ~100-140s, 2h ~240-280s; 1h/30m/15m capture would be many minutes each). The 6 fine-TF cells' CAPTURE (A/C/p05/beta) is therefore REUSED VERBATIM from the committed per-cell artifacts engine_HMA_{1h,30m,15m}_{7d,14d}.json (same capture infra + git SHA, identical capture leg) rather than recomputed; their CLEAN WEALTH was freshly computed in-process here. Coarse-TF capture (1d/4h/2h) was computed fresh in-process this session and matches the committed values. Within a TF the engine wealth is identical across 7d/14d windows: run_wealth's hold provider is the band ensemble's own cross logic (window sets the capture lookback, not the wealth hold), so the two windows differ only in capture A/C/p05, not in compound.
